lyrics:
[Intro: soft synthesizer pad, slow kick, a single bell tone]

[Verse 1: weathered male tenor, hushed]
I've got a bag that's always packed
I've got a talent for the door
Every town I ever lived in
I was gone a year before

[Verse 2: bass enters, voice a little stronger]
I told myself that I was free
I told myself I travel light
Truth is, I never learned the thing
You do when it's the second night

[Pre-Chorus: synths rising]
I'm tired of the highway
I'm tired of my own advice

[Chorus: gospel choir enters, full]
Teach me how to stay
I know how to leave
Show me what you do
When it's hard, and it's Tuesday, and you don't believe
I want to learn the other thing
Teach me how to stay

[Verse 3: voice open, drums fuller]
You've been in this house for thirty years
Same street, same people, same old tree
I used to think that was a cage
I think it might have been the key

[Chorus: gospel choir, lead soaring above]
Teach me how to stay
I know how to leave
Show me what you do
When it's hard, and it's Tuesday, and you don't believe
I want to learn the other thing
Teach me how to stay

[Bridge: choir and lead trading]
(Put the bag down) I'm putting it down
(Take your coat off) It's off, it's off
(Sit) I'm sitting

[Final Chorus: choir at full power, lead ad-libbing]
Teach me how to stay
I know how to leave
Show me what you do
When it's hard, and it's Tuesday, and you don't believe
I want to learn the other thing
Teach me how to stay

[Outro: choir humming, a suitcase unzipped]
producerBrief:
TEMPO / KEY / FEEL: 58 BPM, 4/4, E-flat minor verses rising to G-flat major choruses. Very slow, hushed and then radiant.

VOICE: Male tenor, worn and slightly hoarse, sung quietly and low in the verses, climbing to a strong, strained high register in the choruses. A large gospel choir joins from the first chorus and trades lines with him in the bridge.

INSTRUMENTS: Warm 1980s synthesizer pads, a slow, heavy kick and gated snare, a fretless-sounding bass, a bell-like keyboard, a gospel choir, a clean electric guitar playing long notes, an organ.

ARRANGEMENT MAP: 0:00 Intro. 0:20 Verse 1. 0:52 Verse 2. 1:24 Pre-chorus. 1:36 Chorus 1, choir in. 2:10 Verse 3. 2:42 Chorus 2. 3:16 Bridge. 3:36 Final chorus. 4:14 Outro, humming and a zip, ends 4:36.

PRODUCTION & MIX: Mid-1980s rock ballad: glossy synths, big reverbed drums, voice dry in front, choir wide and warm.

SIGNATURE MOMENT: The choir's entrance on 'Teach me how to stay' at 1:36.

MODERN POINT OF VIEW: The original asks to be shown love as if it were a place. An older man knows the place and has left it many times; what he lacks is the skill of not going.

EMOTIONAL ARC: Restless, honest, humbled, staying.
